track.name: Ran To Atlanta (feat. Future & Molly Santana)

wiki.summary: “Ran To Atlanta” reunites one of hip-hop’s most iconic duos together back, alongside a guest appearance with underground rapper Molly Santana. It serves as the first song Drake and Future have done together since their highly publicized fallout over Kendrick Lamar’s diss on Future and Metro Boomin’s March 2024 song, “Like That.” The title comes from a notable line Kendrick said on his April 2024 diss track, “Not Like Us,” where he poked fun at Drake for only collaborating with Atlanta artists only to make some money: Read more on Last.fm.
